song-hole-sea.title: Hole in the Bottom of the Sea
how: We pick what goes in the hole!
Sing each verse, then pick one more thing.
Point to what you want next!

Here a moo, there a moo, everywhere a moo moo
Old MacDonald had a farm, E-I-E-I-O

Old MacDonald had a farm, E-I-E-I-O

Old MacDonald had a farm, E-I-E-I-O

With a quack quack here, and a quack quack there
Here a quack, there a quack, everywhere a quack quack
Old MacDonald had a farm, E-I-E-I-O

Old MacDonald had a farm, E-I-E-I-O

song-under-the-sea.title: Under the Sea
how: Swim like a fish!
Wiggle and dance with David.
song-under-the-sea.lyrics:
{leaf, wave}
The seaweed is always greener
In somebody else’s lake
You dream about going up there
But that is a big mistake
Just look at the world around you
Right here on the [ocean floor](shell)
Such wonderful things surround you
What more is you looking for

[Chorus]
{crab, tropical fish}
Under the sea, under the sea
Darlin’ it’s better
Down where it’s wetter,
Take it from me
Up on the shore they work all day
Out [in the sun](sun) they slave away
While we devotin’
Full time to floatin’
Under the sea

{tropical fish, fish}
Down here all the fish are happy
As off through the waves they roll
The fish on the land ain’t happy
They're sad 'cause they're in a [bowl](fish)
But fish in the bowl is lucky
They're in for a worser fate
One day when the boss gets hungry
Guess who’s goin’ be on the plate

[Chorus]
{crab, blowfish}
Under the sea, under the sea
Nobody beats us
Fry us and eat us in fricasee
We what the land folks love to cook
Under the sea we off the hook
We got no troubles life is the bubbles
Under the sea,
Since life is sweet here
We got the beat here naturally
Even the [sturgeon](fish) an’ the [ray](dolphin)
They get the urge an’ start to play
We got the spirit
You got to hear it under the sea

{trumpet, saxophone}
The newt play the flute,
The carp play the harp
The plaice play the bass,
And they're soundin’ sharp.
The bass play the brass,
The chub play the tub
The fluke is the duke of soul

{violin, microphone}
The ray he can play,
The ling’s on the strings
The trout rockin’ out,
The blackfish she sings
The smelt and the sprat,
They know where it’s at
An’ Oh. That [blowfish](blowfish) blow

[Chorus]
{fish, notes}
Under the sea (under the sea)
Under the sea (under the sea)
When the sardine
Begin the beguine it’s music to me

{lobster, drum}
What do they got, a lot of sand
We got a hot crustacean band
Each little [clam](oyster) here
Know how to jam here under the sea
Each little [slug](snail) here
Cutin’ a rug here under the sea

{snail, octopus}
Each little snail here
Know how to wail here
That’s why it’s hotter under the water
Ya' we in luck here
Down in the muck here under the sea!!

song-here-comes-sun.title: Here Comes the Sun
how: Make a big sun with your arms!
Sing “here comes the sun” with David.
song-here-comes-sun.lyrics:
[Chorus]
{sun}
Here comes the sun. Here comes the sun.
And I say "it's all right."

{snowman}
Little darling, it's been a long, cold lonely [winter](snowflake)
Little darling, it feels like years since it's been here.

[Chorus]
{sun}
Here comes the sun. Here comes the sun.
And I say "it's all right."

{smile}
Little darling, the smiles returning to their faces.
Little darling, it seems like years since it's been here.

[Chorus]
{sun}
Here comes the sun. Here comes the sun.
And I say "it's all right."

{sun, sparkles}
Sun, sun, sun, here it comes.
Sun, sun, sun, here it comes.
Sun, sun, sun, here it comes.
Sun, sun, sun, here it comes.

{ice}
Little darling, I feel that ice is slowly melting.
Little darling, it seems like years since it's been clear.

[Chorus]
{sun}
Here comes the sun. Here comes the sun.
And I say "it's all right."

song-happy-trails.title: Happy Trails
how: Ride your horse! Giddy-up!
Wave goodbye at the end.
song-happy-trails.lyrics:
[Chorus]
{racehorse, cowboy}
Happy trails to you until we meet again
Happy trails to you keep smiling until then
Who cares about the [clouds](cloud) when we're together
Just sing a song and bring the [sunny weather](sun)
Happy trails to you till we meet a-gain

{happy, sad}
Some trails are happy ones
Others are blue
It’s the way you ride the trail that counts
Here’s a happy one for you

song-la-bamba.title: La Bamba
how: Dance with David!
Shout “Bamba!” together.
song-la-bamba.lyrics:
{dance, maracas}
Para bailar la Bamba
Para bailar la Bamba se necesita una poca de gracia
una poca de gracia pa' mi pa' ti y arriba y arriba
ah y arriba y arriba por ti sere, por ti seré, por ti seré

{ship, anchor}
Yo no soy marinero
yo no soy marinero soy capitan
soy capitan soy capitan

[Chorus]
{guitar, maracas}
Bamba, Bamba
Bamba, Bamba
Bamba, Bamba
Bamba

song-fly-me-moon.title: Fly Me to the Moon
how: Point up to the moon and the stars!
song-fly-me-moon.lyrics:
{moon, rocket}
Fly me to the moon,
Let me play among the [stars](star)
Let me see what spring is like on a-[Jupiter and Mars](planet)

{handshake}
In other words: hold my hand,
In other words: baby, kiss me

{notes, heart}
Fill my heart with song and let me sing for ever more
You are all I long for,
All I worship and adore

{heart}
In other words: please, be true,
In other words: I love you

song-over-rainbow.title: Over the Rainbow
how: Draw a big rainbow in the air with your hand.
song-over-rainbow.lyrics:
{rainbow}
Somewhere over the rainbow,
Way up high
There's a land that I heard of,
Once in a [lullaby](sleepy)

{rainbow, cloud}
Somewhere over the rainbow,
Skies are blue
And the [dreams](sparkles) that you dare to dream
Really do come true

{star, cloud}
Someday I'll wish upon a star
And wake up where the clouds are far behind me
Where troubles melt like [lemon drops](lemon)
Away above the [chimney tops](house)
That's where you'll find me

{bird, rainbow}
Somewhere over the rainbow,
Bluebirds fly
Birds fly over the rainbow,
Why then, oh, why can't I?

{bird}
If happy little bluebirds fly beyond the rainbow,
Why, oh why can't I?

song-hound-dog.title: Hound Dog
how: Dance like Elvis!
Can you bark like a dog?
song-hound-dog.lyrics:
{dog}
You ain't nothin' but a hound dog, hound dog
Cryin' all the time
You ain't nothin' but a hound dog
Cryin' all the time
Well, you ain't never caught a [rabbit](rabbit)
And you ain't no friend of mine

{dog, crown}
When they said you was high-classed
Well, that was just a lie
Yeah, they said you were high-classed
Well, that was just a lie
Yeah, you ain't never caught a [rabbit](rabbit)
And you ain't no friend of mine

song-lean-on-me.title: Lean On Me
how: Sway side to side with your friends.
song-lean-on-me.lyrics:
{sad}
Sometimes in our lives we all have pain,
We all have sorrow
But if we are wise,
We know that there's always [tomorrow](sun)

{hug}
Lean on me, when you're not strong,
And I'll be your friend
I'll help you carry on

{friends}
For it won't be long,
’Til I'm gonna need,
Somebody to lean on

{handshake}
Please swallow your pride,
If I have things you need to borrow
For no one can fill those of your needs,
That you won't let show

{friends, heart}
You just call on me brother, when you need a [hand](hand)
We all need somebody to lean on
I just might have a problem that you'll understand
We all need somebody to lean on

{arm}
If there is a load you have to bear,
That you can't carry
I'm right up the [road](car),
I’ll share your load, if you just call me

song-bare-necessities.title: The Bare Necessities
how: Scratch your back like a bear!
Dance like Baloo.
song-bare-necessities.lyrics:
{bear}
Look for the bare necessities,
The simple bare necessities
Forget about your worries and your strife

{bear, flower}
I mean the bare necessities,
Old Mother Nature's recipes
That brings the bare necessities of life

{bee, honey}
Wherever I wander, wherever I roam,
I couldn't be fonder of my big home
The [bees](bee) are buzzin' in the tree
To make some honey just for me
When you look under the [rocks](rock) and plants

{ant}
And take a glance at the fancy [ants](ant),
Then maybe try a few…
The bare necessities of life will come to you,
They’ll come to you!

{bear}
Look for the bare necessities,
The simple bare necessities
Forget about your worries and your strife

{bear zzz}
I mean the bare necessities,
That’s why a bear can rest at ease
With just the bare necessities of life
